limitations: Authored software fixtures, not field evidence.
No browser, IndexedDB transaction, camera or download completion test.

results.name: No records are invented for an empty workspace
Migration excludes synthetic reports, illustrative media and synthetic coordinates
Field pack round-trip preserves original words, unknowns, filename, context and bytes
Changed bytes fail integrity validation before import
Changed digest, media size and MIME fail validation
Missing local media is counted without invented replacement bytes
Metadata-only export never reads private media bytes
Existing JSON receipts and collections remain importable
Synthetic evidence is rejected even in a single receipt
Duplicate import is idempotent despite property ordering
Conflicting report IDs preserve existing original and review decisions
Shared media IDs with different metadata block merging
Unreferenced or repeated embedded media cannot enter storage
Malformed JSON, unsupported versions, empty collections and repeated record IDs are rejected
Record limit prevents partial overflow imports
Review search matches words across site, note and ID while honoring status
SVG or script-like payload MIME cannot enter a field pack
Export rejects locally altered originals instead of emitting a misleading hash
All three bundled source photographs match the recorded digest and decode as JPEG
Reference drafts retain source dates and leave words, readings and coordinates unknown
Source day precision never becomes an invented midnight or a shifted local date
A historical photo review round-trips with licence, source and unchanged source bytes
Public photos cannot be imported as firsthand uploads after stripping attribution
Unknown or altered source credits cannot enter the workspace
Historical review rejects invented field coordinates, instrument readings or context
Historical photo date and site cannot be relabeled as a new visit
Reference media cannot be removed or replaced with unrelated bytes
Receipt, CSV and graph explicitly distinguish photographer from review author
